scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/landing-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && bun run bin/prerender-landing.ts
scripts.cap:android:sync: bun run cap:build && cap sync android
scripts.cap:android:dev: PAYKY_DISABLE_BASIC_SSL=1 bun run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --strictPort & PAYKY_VITE_PID=$!; trap 'kill $PAYKY_VITE_PID' EXIT; until curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:5173 >/dev/null; do kill -0 $PAYKY_VITE_PID || exit 1; sleep 0.25; done; cap run android --live-reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --forwardPorts 5173:5173; wait $PAYKY_VITE_PID
scripts.cap:android:build:debug: bun run cap:android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.cap:android:build:apk: : ${PAYKY_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD:?Set PAYKY_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD} && : ${PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS:?Set PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS} && : ${PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD:?Set PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD} && bun run cap:android:sync && cap build android --androidreleasetype APK --signing-type apksigner --keystorepath ../payky-release.keystore --keystorepass "$PAYKY_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" --keystorealias "$PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" --keystorealiaspass "$PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD"
scripts.cap:android:build:aab: : ${PAYKY_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD:?Set PAYKY_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD} && : ${PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS:?Set PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS} && : ${PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD:?Set PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD} && bun run cap:android:sync && cap build android --androidreleasetype AAB --keystorepath ../payky-release.keystore --keystorepass "$PAYKY_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" --keystorealias "$PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" --keystorealiaspass "$PAYKY_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD"
scripts.cap:ios:sync: bun run cap:build && cap sync ios
scripts.cap:ios:run: bun run cap:ios:sync && cap run ios
scripts.check: bun run check:lint && bun run check:ts && bun run check:decisions && bun run check:tests
scripts.docs:videos: bun run docs:videos:capture && bun run docs:videos:render
scripts.test:e2e:preview: PAYKY_E2E_BUILD=1 VITE_PAYKY_EET_PRODUCTION_URL=https://eet-production.invalid/eet/services/EETServiceSOAP/v4 bun run build && PAYKY_E2E_SERVER=preview playwright test
